essence: The salutation is directed to the deity Gaṇeśa.
One should form the six limbs in sequence with the seed syllable endowed with six long vowels.
After meditating and worshipping mentally, one should perform the placement of arghya.
The rite should be completed up to the dismissal beginning from incense and so forth.
The wise have declared the eight substances of Vighna.
